_comment: Encatch helpdesk configuration (support tiers, SLAs, automation rules). Apply with apply.py; see README.md. Times are business hours on the desk's default business hours.

support_tier_attribute.name: Support tier
support_tier_attribute.description: Customer's support tier; drives SLA policies. Empty = SaaS Standard.

sla_policies.name: SaaS Standard
sla_policies.description: SaaS Standard tier: first reply within 48 business hours.

sla_policies.name: SaaS Growth
sla_policies.description: SaaS Growth tier: first reply within 24 business hours.

sla_policies.name: Priority support - Normal
sla_policies.description: Growth Plus and Enterprise Standard, Low/Medium priority: 24 business hours.

sla_policies.name: Priority support - Express
sla_policies.description: Growth Plus and Enterprise Standard, High priority: 8 business hours.

sla_policies.name: Priority support - Priority
sla_policies.description: Growth Plus and Enterprise Standard, Urgent priority: 2 business hours.

sla_policies.name: Enterprise Premium - Low
sla_policies.description: Enterprise Premium, Low priority: 16 business hours.

sla_policies.name: Enterprise Premium - Medium
sla_policies.description: Enterprise Premium, Medium priority: 8 business hours.

sla_policies.name: Enterprise Premium - High

_tiers_comment: Priority -> SLA policy per tier. Tiers without a 'priorities' map get one SLA whatever the priority.
_subject_tags_comment: Subject keywords (case-insensitive) that set the starting priority on new tickets, for tiers with a 'priorities' map.
